svg.title: TYPHON / Complete opportunity solution tree
svg.desc: Opportunity solution tree, with a separate result box directly to the right of each completed experiment or evidence activity.
svg.text: 12 October 2026 · Results: green = bounded improvement · amber = mixed · rose = negative · blue = evidence · purple = review · Dashed = review or unrun

g.title: Outcome: Personally recorded manipulation data drives reliable Panda feeding and measured loading transfer
Opportunity: I need my recordings to contribute to robot behaviour with traceable supervision
Solution: Traceable curation and explicit calibration
Audit: Excluded-take provenance audit OPS04 · #10981 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Excluded review candidate 6 is demo0017, not successful demo0006. Candidate 5 is normal demo0016. Source clips and hashes preserved.
Experiment: Physical DUPLO + calibration DATA06 · #10991 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Calibration/proxy mismatch explicitly reconciled: frozen training 50 x 35 x 30 mm,80 g versus catalogue 32 x 43 x 32 mm,12.7 g; target square virtual 100 mm. Actual measurements and paired-camera metric calibration remain missing. Do not silently replace geometry or call virtual units physical accuracy. Waiting for measurement/calibration evidence; original results unchanged.
Solution: Event alignment and constrained retargeting
Experiment: Human / expert event timeline R07 · #10972 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: One 7.6 s human correction aligned by events; camera sync uncertainty ±0.25 s. Human lift/rotation overlap differs from the teacher. Not valid motor-action labels.
Experiment: Human endpoint retargeting R09 · #10974 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: One endpoint-derived, constrained Panda execution succeeds: 2.46 mm / 0.081° from the mapped endpoint. Virtual scale and supplied path/timing; not recovered human 3D actions.
Experiment: Phone-to-Panda action alignment DATA04 · #10989 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Phone-to-robot alignment audit completed; full direct supervision remains blocked. Existing one-clip event alignment has 7.6 s duration and+-0.25 s sync uncertainty; human lift/rotation overlap differs from teacher phase timing. Endpoint retarget succeeds with supplied path/height/timing; it is not full recovered 3 D. SixP_train tracking sources audited for observable segments, but grasp/release correspondence and metric lift are not established. Proposed reusable object-motion/contact representation recorded; no invented per-frame motor labels.
Solution: Balanced phase, horizon and view mixtures
Experiment: Phase chunks + 4 s intentions DATA02 · #10987 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Actual chunk/target audit completed. V 2 has 632 rows=316 semantic chunks x 2 view orders; V 3 has 776/388. Future durations vary, and four-second history is not four-second future supervision. Broad-Pt and new continuations predict 30 actions at 20 Hz=1.5 s. Human footage remains without validated frame-to-Franka-action labels. Missing held sidecars use validity masks. Proceed with explicitly versioned physical-time contracts; do not claim uniform four-second intention targets.
Experiment: Balanced data randomisation DATA03 · #10988 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Sampling audit completed: broad 12 k all 439 windows,48,000 exposures,8,000/source. V 1/V 2 historical aggregate logs cover declared sources; V 2 semantic/view copies and category balancing do not imply uniform source weighting. Historical V 3 per-update consumption remains unverified. New fixed/varied/recovery runs retain every sample identity and exact 2,000/source exposure, independently shuffled window queues and a shared shuffled cell schedule.
Experiment: Held crosshair + separate labels DATA05 · #10990 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Historical phone held export verified on Mint:16 takes,32 views,7,904 view-frames;1,024 held,3,598 notheld,3,282 unknown;768 green-on frames. Unknown/off is not a negative held label. Marker is a pseudo 3 Dimage bracket, not metric 3 D. Source timestamps/audio retained; frame-level labels are agent-reviewed, not all human-confirmed. Export predates the later evaluation exclusion. No direct Franka labels attach to phone frames.
Solution: Object, hand and temporal visual representations
Experiment: Video-derived representation and robot adapter VIDEO01 · #11015 ACTIVE · RESULTS PENDING

Interim result: Three phone representations, dense alignment and held-state probes tested. Video can supervise a small observation head; transition false positives remain. No qualified metric/contact stream or Panda action decoder.
Experiment: Object motion from phone frames VIDEO01-A · #11016 REVIEW

Result · review: 440/526 centres and 227/264 primary directed-yaw estimates pass confidence filters. Actual 2D paths, missing masks and shuffle/static controls saved. Coverage is not accuracy; no physical 3D or grasp inference.
Experiment: Hand/pinch motion from phone frames VIDEO01-B · #11017 REVIEW

Result · review: Hands detected in 175/526 sampled frames. Pinch midpoint/aperture and hand-centred landmarks saved; grasp/global depth remain unknown. Static no-hand frames are expected, so this is not recall.
Experiment: Frozen visual features across views VIDEO01-C · #11018 REVIEW

Result · review: Frozen Pt backbone: 526 x 1024 descriptors; pooled paired-take retrieval 1/16. Frame timing and shuffle/reversal controls saved. Offline future-aware comparison; pooled features do not encode temporal order.
Experiment: Dense video, crops and ordered observations VIDEO02 · #11019 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Corrected v2: 2,644 frames verified against raw decoding; 147 four-second windows. Full+crop timing error 2.09 to 1.21 s; 13/16 takes improve. Ordered retrieval 7/16 vs pooled 1/16. Earlier frame-index bug preserved and fixed. No robot-action labels.
Experiment: Predict held state from unmarked phone video VIDEO03 · #11020 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 35 small probes; 155/155 known interiors agree. Transition false-held: full 5/8, crop 2/8. Cross-view recall: crop 28/28, +history 23/28; history helps a different session panel. Missing hard negatives; no control authority.
Experiment: Test training-only hand-present negatives VIDEO04 · #11021 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 12 training-only withdrawal views added; 90/90 held interiors retained. Extra negatives 2/6 to 1/6 view errors, same 1/3 approach event still fails. Reused challenge 2/4 to 1/4 failing events. Weight/history adds no gain; no control authority.
Experiment: Add pre-contact negatives and audit held pauses VIDEO05 · #11022 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 13 training pre-contact views added. Old challenge 1/8 to 0/8 false held; new views 2/5 to 1/5 with current features, history stays 2/5. Same excluded take still fails. 90/90 held interiors retained. Held-pause qualification incomplete.
Experiment: Check observed motion through occlusion VIDEO06 · #11023 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 6 takes; 342 frames. Glyph flow: 194/222 held pairs; 53 lacked old centroid motion. 28 rejected. Demo15 moves in both views. No strict held-pause panel. 28 trace files reproduce; no robot-control claim.
Experiment: Test native cadence and phase timing VIDEO07 · #11024 NEXT · NOT RUN
Opportunity: I need the robot to see and use the correct brick orientation
g.text: I need the robot to see and

g.title: Solution: Resolution-preserving views and temporal context
Audit: Numeral visibility audit R01e · #10959 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 12 saved input packets checked. One blue fragment shrinks from 8×4 to 2×1 px after resizing. That is a fragment, not the whole image or proof of recognition failure.

a.text: That is a fragment, not the

g.title: Audit: Actual image and history audit R01c · #10955 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Two current camera images: 512 → 224 px. Six earlier frames are supplied as pooled features. No object crop at release. Receiving history does not prove the model uses it.
Experiment: Visibility remediation VIS01 · #10993 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 108 visibility predictions: enlarging the held numeral increased feature sensitivity, but wrist error remained about 80 degrees and opening stayed at waypoint 11. Crop-only fix rejected; semantic numeral recognition remains unresolved.
Solution: Visual-goal and language conditioning
Experiment: Numeral + coherent-goal probes R01b · #10954 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 87 offline queries on three states from one episode. Initial numeral rotation changes wrist targets by 26–34°. Held-state target stays about 94°; cue recognition versus action use remains unresolved.
Experiment: Simple-action prompt probes R02 · #10960 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 36 fixed-state/noise predictions. Wording changes actions, but “move +X/−X”, approach and extend do not reliably produce the requested primitive.
Experiment: Vanilla / V3 / V4 prompt controls R02b · #10961 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 180 predictions across vanilla, V3 and V4. Each model: 0/18 paired direction reversals and 0/6 open/close reversals. Native input contracts differ.
Experiment: Perception vs action mapping R01f · #11011 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 108 visibility predictions: enlarging the held numeral increased feature sensitivity, but wrist error remained about 80 degrees and opening stayed at waypoint 11. Crop-only fix rejected; semantic numeral recognition remains unresolved.
Experiment: Language / action grounding repair VIS02 · #10994 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Matched goal-diversity test completed: same broad-Pt 12 k initializer, +3,000 joint updates, 12,000 samples and 2,000/source in each arm. Six fixed-goal trajectories versus 12 varied-goal trajectories. Novel start/goal strict success: fixed 0/12, varied 10/12; original source 7/12 versus 10/12; loading 0/12 both. Six already-seen source families, one fit seed; not independent new demonstrations. A further 18 fixed-image queries per arm found at most 1.381 mm/fixed and 0.977 mm/varied endpoint response to a 270 mm text-only goal change. Proceed with visually
Solution: Visual completion checks and goal references
Experiment: Simple visual completion test LIVE02 · #11005 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Completion qualification finished with negative result. Frozen classical checks fail 80%recall gates on the 168-image two-panel study; reference conjunction reduces false positives but misses valid poses. A separate static DecisionsAPI panel, not the user's live-ranking role, gives 2/22 true-positive recall excluding identical references and 0 false completions. No completion authority granted.
Experiment: Qwen + finished-reference image LIVE03 · #11006 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Historical Qwen 3-VL-2 B-Instruct service audited: a 180 degree false-positive completion was vetoed by independent RGB reference; old 3 candidateTTC ranked a smoothness heuristic, not learned value. Current live ranking uses DecisionsAPI under LIVE 04. Qwen weights are archived on Mint, no newly qualified Qwen control authority.
Opportunity: I need learned behaviour to work beyond familiar starting states
Solution: Broader supervised adaptation
Training: Broader full-weight Pt adaptation R03 · #10962 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Fresh X-VLA-Pt; all six training takes; 439 simulated RGB/expert windows. 3k and 12k checkpoints saved in 64 min. Full-weight adaptation after staged warm-up.
Experiment: Unchanged development evaluation R03b · #10963 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Narrow M6, broad 3k and broad 12k each grasp 0/6 and complete 0/6. Three development families × two seeds; previously inspected, not a fresh confirmatory test.
Experiment: Familiar-start diagnostic R03c · #10964 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Broad 12k on six exact training starts: 6/6 grasps and lifts; 5/6 stable released placements inside the square; 4/6 strict successes. One seed per start.
Solution: Coverage-driven training and correction examples
Audit: Training-start coverage audit R03d · #10965 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: All three development starts lie outside the six training-start XY convex hull. Initial-position coverage mismatch is established; causality is not.
Experiment: 16 trials: local position and yaw robustness NEXT01 · #10983 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 16 local trials: 14 grasps, 14 stable released in-square placements, 13 strict successes. Original 4/4; inward 3/4; outward 4/4; yaw 2/4. Two selected familiar parents; not broad transfer.
Experiment: Failure / correction coverage DATA07 · #10992 REVIEW

Result · review: Four distinct qualified training-only direct corrections admitted from twoP_trainfamilies after replay, action/proprio roundtrip, finite and joint-limit checks. One near-limit source excluded; duplicate removed. Added to a separate 3,000 update recovery continuation;0/4 quarantined recovery success. This partially covers failures, not all requested pause/no-op/repair families. Broader recovery coverage depends on CTRL 01.
Experiment: Why B/loading does not generalise B01 · #11013 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Loading: 28 rollouts and 18 fixed-image queries. Verified V1–V3 data: 18 feeding, 0 loading. Broad12k returns to feeding square; endpoint changes <1 mm for 270 mm goal shift. Expert 8/8 feasible.
Opportunity: I need a grasped brick placed and released in the correct orientation
Solution: Grasp-relative orientation control
Experiment: Release command trace R01 · #10957 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Policy requests OPEN at 3.60 s; controller passes it through. Wrist target ≈93°, but this grasp needs ≈174°. Keeping the gripper closed still leaves ≈80° error.
Experiment: Proprioception input ablation R01d · #10958 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Using measured end-effector pose delays opening from waypoint 11 to 13–14. Orientation error remains 79–85°. Offline input ablation; not a validated fix.
Experiment: Two supplied grasp-state panels R05b · #10968 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Eight proposals per supplied grasp state. Off-axis grasp: ≈85° yaw error. Near-expert grasp: <1°; 7/8 stable releases inside. Strict success 0/16. State/history confounded.
Experiment: Observed vs truth grasp transform NEXT03 · #10985 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Two source-held states: truth 2/2 strict, RGB 2/2. Centre error: truth 1.5–2.1 mm, RGB 12.1–12.6 mm. Established expert grasps and diagnostic handoff; no VLA improvement demonstrated.
Solution: Replanning cadence and joint-aware paths
Experiment: 30 vs 10 actions before looking R04 · #10966 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: H30: 2/12 grasps and in-square placements. H10: 0/12 grasps. Strict success: 0 for both. Mean wall time 22.76 versus 43.94 s; matched first-action prefixes.
Experiment: Joint-aware paths + regrasp CTRL01 · #10998 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Staged set-down/regrasp tested on six exact quarantined historical failure states:1/6 strict. Five stopped for executed installed-joint-limit violations. Four started within limits; the fifth other-family handoff was already 9.47 e-6 radoutside and is explicitly marked. No full collision qualification. Two earlier logging-instrumentation failures are invalid experiments and excluded. Do not use failed oracle paths as labels.
Opportunity: I need recovery without blocking valid actions or repeating completed work
Solution: Observed-state phase supervisor
Experiment: Phase guard vs V4 vs primitives R06 · #10969 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Unmodified V4 grasps 2/6; phase guard 0/6 with 1,126 close vetoes. Primitives pick up 2/6, complete 0/6 new tasks. All three routes preserve 2/2 already-complete cases.
Experiment: Post-release projection fix R06b · #10970 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Same images, corrected tabletop projection: position error 16–19 mm → 0.44–0.66 mm. Recognised successes 0/3 → 2/3; physical success stays 3/6.
Experiment: Passive observer repair NEXT02 · #10984 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Four passive observation variants evaluated on 8 exact replays/1,219 frames each. No variant qualifies: pose/held precision-recall and phase-transition errors remain. Replay policy/physics unchanged. Do not grant veto or advancement authority. Proceed only with targeted observation repair and a new qualification panel.
Experiment: Hard movement boundaries CTRL02 · #10999 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Guard/service audit completed with 27 tests passing. Measured 7 joint positions/velocities, finite inputs, installed joint ranges, workspace and 15 mm-expanded no-go AABB checked; proposedEEFsegments checked. Historical 36 successful expert replays had 0 rejections. These checks do not certify whole-arm collisions or executedIKfeasibility. Separate recovery stress found executed joint-limit excursions; preserve violation logs.
Solution: Qualified primitives and recovery experts
Experiment: Two-axis IK endpoint selector R06c · #10971 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: On six training takes, success drops from 3/6 to 1/6. A reachable inverse-kinematics endpoint does not ensure a feasible executed path. Selector rejected.
Experiment: Expert recovery from V4 failures R08 · #10973 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Six exact failure states × two experts. Nominal recovery 2/6; grasp-aware 3/6. Original off-axis case repaired. Five successful suffixes kept out of training.
Experiment: Explicit primitive-call adapter R11 · #10976 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: External typed primitive adapter works. Skill route: 2/6 pickups, 0/6 new completions. X-VLA still emits continuous actions; it does not natively call tools.
Experiment: Live controller + harness hookup LIVE01 · #11004 REVIEW

Result · review: Telemetry/guard tests pass and a current asynchronous Decisions integration smoke ran end-to-end on broad 12 k with full commands/RGB/joint traces. Both smoke modes failed task success; delayed-prefix eligibility rejected many commands. This is infrastructure evidence, not a qualified live harness or matched unmodifiedV 4 comparison. Keep deployment gated on LIVE 04 and observation reliability.
Solution: Confidence-gated phase prediction
Experiment: Causal phase predictor R12 · #10977 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 347 training / 179 validation frames. Accuracy 63.7%, macro-F1 0.592, including early release errors. The 90% selective-accuracy gate fails; predictor disabled.
Experiment: High-level skill selector HIER01 · #11000 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Proceed decision: do not train a skill selector yet. Candidate primitives/phase observer remain unqualified and staged recovery 1/6. A learned high-level selector would confound selection quality with inability to execute/recognise completion. Resume after CTRL 01/NEXT 02 pass. No hierarchical selector training claimed.
Solution: Learner-state correction and bounded residual repair
Review: Hierarchical / RL method review R13 · #10978 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: DAgger, options, residual RL, offline Q and PPO reviewed. Qualify expert recovery before correction training. No new RL training was performed.
Experiment: Learner-state imitation / DAgger REL01 · #11001 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: One separate offline DAgger-style aggregation iteration completed: four qualified correction paths from two P_train families plus six nominal paths;3,000 joint updates from broad 12 k. Four quarantined demo 0006 handoffs: recovery 0/4 strict, all three controls also 0/4. No teacher at evaluation; no RL. The six-state original stress set was narrowed to four because other states overlap source training families. Preserve failed cases and expand qualified correction coverage before scaling.
Experiment: Residual repair learning REL02 · #11002 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Proceed decision: supervised correction was tested first under REL 01 and scored 0/4 quarantined states. Current observers and recovery primitives fail qualification. Do not launch residualRLon an unqualified baseline; first establish supported residual actions, reliable state/reward interface and source-disjoint recovery coverage. No residualRLrun claimed.
Experiment: Offline Q / PPO / DPPO REL03 · #11003 BLOCKED · PREREQUISITE FAILED

Result · review: Proceed decision: offline candidate oracle has weak grasp availability and narrow state support; live ranking has no qualified gain. PPO/DPPO is not a drop-in replacement for this flow action model. NoQ/PPOtraining launched. Require a frozen supported-action/reward protocol and qualified execution before this comparison.
Opportunity: I need extra inference to produce better actions
Solution: Multiple candidate action chunks
Experiment: Best-of-eight offline oracle R05 · #10967 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 48 proposals over six states. Random-to-best-of-eight oracle approach availability: 72.9% → 83.3%. Grasp-capable states remain 1/6. Privileged offline scoring only.
Solution: Visual critic over projected futures
Prototype: Blue ghosts + typed critic inputs R10a · #10975 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 64 simulated candidate futures / 32 blue-ghost slates prepared with typed choices. Luna calls: 0. This validates critic inputs, not ranking quality.
Experiment: Luna visual ranking R10 · #10982 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Frozen Decisions API ranking finished using the user-authorized credential, with no secret in artifacts.32 choice requests plus 32 separate reason requests over original/supplement panels. Six original states: ghost 2/3 adequate selections with 9 abstentions; futureRGB 5/5 with 7 abstentions; median 857 ms/1466 ms. Many abstentions occurred despite adequate candidates. Supplemental held-state strict adequacy 0/8 in each state; visual-goal sufficiency is scored separately. Simulator future images are privileged lookahead, not a deployable world model. Conditional chosen accuracy does not establish
Experiment: Live Decisions API ranking LIVE04 · #11014 REVIEW

Result · review: Live ranker prototype implemented and 8 regression tests pass: batched 4 proposals, asynchronous bounded 1 inflight request, exact observation/candidate IDs, deadline/stale rejection, guard recheck, retained tensors. First 40 s broad 12 kdevelopment smoke:56 valid APIresponses,55 UNKNOWN,1 candidate;48 late beyond 500 ms total budget;0 APIselected motions,3 fallback chunks. APIp 50=381 ms,p 95 about 1002 ms plus proposal/preview overhead. Both ranked and first-admissible scheduler trials fail strict success. Blue projectedEEFpaths are not full arm/object futures. Prefix skipping rejects delayedgrip transitions; redesign handoff scheduling before comparison to unmodifiedV 4. Not deployment-ready.
Opportunity: I need comparable results that show what actually worked
Solution: Matched evaluations with explicit limitations
Experiment: Earlier 775-rollout comparison EVAL01 · #10995 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 775 feeding trials reconciled:155 scenes x 5 models, no harness/TTC. On 137 unfinished scenes,70 mm pickups vanilla/V 1/V 2/V 3/V 4=0/0/0/10/1; new upright stable placements=0/0/0/5/1. Original strict passes all started complete.
Experiment: Earlier A/B harness comparison EVAL03 · #10997 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Historical 400 AB rows reconciled:5 models x 2 modes x 20 A/20 B. All strict/pickup/place outcomes 0. Matched initial-state/config hashes retained. Harness had 30 s wall cap and one candidate; noTTC. Budget stops are separated from runtime errors in report/historical-ab 400.json. This synthetic panel is distinct from 775 feeding and the new 136+160 panels.
Experiment: 204 paired rollouts: vanilla / broad 12k / intervention EVAL02 · #10996 REVIEW

Result · review: The two baseline arms completed 136 rollouts across 34 frozen layouts x 2 seeds. Broad 12 k near-personal:31/40 supported grasps,22/40 stable placements,17/40 strict; vanilla 0/40. Broader starts:both 0/20. Already-completed preservation:broad 8/8 strict,vanilla 1/8; broad still moved the arm. Native domain/input contracts differ, so whole-recipe comparison. Family-bootstrap uncertainty saved; not 136 independent humans. Planned 68 intervention rollouts were not run because observer qualification failed. Two invalid boundary layouts were clipped 1.64/2.82 mm before any policy action under a versioned protocol.
Review: Research report + independent review OPS03 · #10980 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 13 research requests reconciled with independent and planner review. Model identities, denominator limits and errata documented.
Solution: Reproducible artifact and model registry
Backup: Weights, traces and recovery backup OPS02 · #10979 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Weights, traces and recovery states preserved with SHA-256 verification on Mint Fast Drive. Backup evidence; no new model-performance result.
Delivery: Research ledger OPS01 · #10956 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 58 original work items recorded with requests, findings, limitations and follow-ups. Administrative evidence; no robot-performance result.
Experiment: Exact model and dataset registry DATA01 · #10986 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Checkpoint and dataset registry saved.19 headers verified, historical M 6 hashes reconciled and three new continuations recorded. V 4 continues V 3; broad-Pt 12 k starts fresh. Native RGB and privileged held/history contracts distinguished.
Experiment: Dashboard + video evidence DEL01 · #11007 REVIEW

Result · review: Media provenance inventory checked:419 existingR 2 entries, including 64 training videos=32 trimmed+32 marked, not spatially cropped. Tested personal/M 3 pilot URLs work; two V 4 M 6 pilot URLs return 404. Local evaluated videos remain archived. No newDrive upload/public publishing in this sweep. Repair missing media URLs separately; dashboard release remains private.
Experiment: Matched video, subgoals, release timeline and four case cards DEL02 · #11008 REVIEW

Result · review: Private research report and model registry prepared: 296 new scored episodes, model identities, negative results, matched-state checks, family uncertainty and reproduction. Public demonstration and broken-media-link repair remain separate; no publication.
Experiment: Draw and verify the research OST OPS05 · #11012 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Five-column OST verified with experiment/result alignment and all historical work retained. Updated12October to include the authorised24-hour plan and B/loading diagnosis.
Opportunity: I need deferred ideas kept separate from the active scope
Solution: Withdrawn or deferred approaches
Experiment: Set-of-Mark object labels PARK01 · #11009 PARKED
Experiment: Platform / simulator expansion PARK02 · #11010 PARKED
